label: The real life and the machine life have the same experiential profile
paraphrase: OPEN case stipulation, analyst formulation after the experience-machine thought experiment (attribution deferred): the two lives compared, a real life and a life plugged into the machine, are indistinguishable from the inside: the profile map gives them the same value. It is the coherence of the case on a phenomenal individuation of profiles; on an individuation by intentional content it could fail.
